sentences.en: They're convenient, but their cool, watery flavor is disappointingly bland.

sentences.en: We believe that despite recent positive progress, this is an area in which English Heritage has remained disappointingly ineffective.

sentences.en: Disappointingly the cocktail piano promised in the title is all too evident, with not an upbeat moment to be found anywhere.

sentences.en: We were expecting far better pyrotechnics on offer when those mutant powers were unleashed, but much of it is disappointingly underwhelming.

sentences.en: The archeological evidence for Anglo-Saxon Herefordshire is disappointingly sparse.

sentences.en: The decider went the way of Tuominen's other winning games, 11/5, with Anjema offering only spasmodic resistance, disappointingly.

sentences.en: These epitomes have been ascribed without sufficient reason to Florus (2nd century); but, though they are probably of even later date, and are disappointingly meagre, they may be taken as giving, so far as they go, a fairly authentic description of the original.
sentences.vi: Những hình ảnh thu nhỏ này đã được gán cho Florus (thế kỷ thứ 2) mà không có đủ lý do; nhưng, mặc dù chúng có thể có niên đại muộn hơn, và ít ỏi một cách đáng thất vọng, nhưng cho đến nay, chúng có thể được coi là một mô tả khá xác thực về bản gốc.

sentences.en: History has disappointingly few examples of weapons made by governments and never used.
